tasks.name: Amulet of Weedspeak
tasks.desc: Buy a Farming amulet from Sarah on the farm north of Port Sarim.
tasks.notes:
Buy an amulet of farming from Sarah at Falador farm.
Sarah can only be found on members' worlds, in the farm house west of the allotment patch.

tasks.name: The Good Stuff
tasks.desc: Buy a stat-boosting beer from a waitress in the Rising Sun tavern.
tasks.notes:
Buy any stat-boosting drink from a waitress in the Rising Sun tavern in western Falador.
The three waitresses are Emily, Kaylee and Tina.

tasks.name: Chain Store
tasks.desc: Buy a black chainbody from Wayne's Chains, and try it on in the shop. (X/2)
tasks.notes:
Buy a black chainbody from Wayne's Chains - Chainmail Specialist and equip it.
The black chainbody will cost 1,440 coins. Wayne's Chains is found in southern Falador, west from the southern entrance to the city.

tasks.name: Sir Mitt
tasks.desc: Climb to the top of the White Knights' Castle.
tasks.notes: Climb to the top floor of the White Knights' Castle.

tasks.name: Family Values
tasks.desc: Discover your family crest from Sir Renitee.
tasks.notes: Speak to Sir Renitee about a family crest.

tasks.name: Sniffing Out the Mole
tasks.desc: Enter the mole lair under Falador Park.
tasks.notes:
Enter the Falador Mole Lair located underneath Falador Park.
The entrance can be found in the western side of Falador Park, by the bridge over the small pond.

tasks.name: Chinchompa Powered!
tasks.desc: Feed Ridgeley, the hairdresser's pet.
tasks.notes: Feed a piece of cheese to Ridgeley, the chinchompa pet of the hairdresser.

tasks.name: Fill Yer Bucket
tasks.desc: Fill a bucket from the pump north of the Falador's west bank.
tasks.notes:
Fill a bucket with water from the water pump found north of Falador west bank.
A bucket can be bought from the nearby general store.

tasks.name: Elementary Medicine
tasks.desc: Heal an elemental wizard by casting an appropriate elemental spell on him.
tasks.notes:
Cast an elemental spell on an elemental wizard in order to heal him. Spells from the Ancient Magicks spellbook also work.
The wizards can be found north-west of Port Sarim, alongside Malignius Mortifer. Whenever they are attacked by a spell of their corresponding element, they are healed instead of damaged, so attacking the air wizard with an air spell will heal him.
If casting a spell does not heal the wizard, attempt again with a different magic weapon as some weapons do not work. The spell casts but the wizard will not heal.

tasks.name: It's Not Wabbit Season
tasks.desc: Kill a duck in Falador Park.
tasks.notes: Kill a duck in Falador Park.

tasks.name: My Way or the Highway
tasks.desc: Kill a highwayman on the road south of Falador.
tasks.notes: Kill a highwayman found south of Falador.

tasks.name: Making My Mind Up
tasks.desc: Make a mind tiara.
tasks.notes:
Make a mind tiara.
A mind tiara can be made by using a mind talisman on the Mind altar, found in the north-east corner of Goblin Village, with a blank tiara in the inventory.

tasks.name: Mudskip the Light Fantastic
tasks.desc: Recharge your Prayer points at the altar south-west of Port Sarim.
tasks.notes: Recharge their prayer points at the altar found south-west of Port Sarim.

tasks.name: Disarm and Embark
tasks.desc: Take the boat to Entrana.
tasks.notes:
Travel to Entrana via boat.
As Entrana is considered a holy place, it is forbidden to take any combat equipment. The monks who transport the player will check and list any items in their inventory or equipped which are forbidden. There is a bank deposit box by the monks. For a more detailed list of permitted and forbidden items, see list of permitted and forbidden items on Entrana.

tasks.name: Going Along With the 'Fro
tasks.desc: Talk to Party Pete in the Party Room.
tasks.notes: Talk to Party Pete in Party Room.

Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.

Ability to use a new emote by operating the shield when worn

tasks.name: Fruit of the Loom
tasks.desc: Craft a fruit basket using the loom at the farm north of Port Sarim.
other: The following is not required if you obtain the willow branches from Spirit implings instead:
tasks.notes: Craft a basket with 6 willow branches using the loom at the Falador farm.

tasks.name: Is It So Hard to Walk Round?
tasks.desc: Crawl under Falador's south wall.
tasks.notes: Pass through the shortcut leading under Falador's south wall.

tasks.name: Climbing the Walls
tasks.desc: Grapple up and then jump off Falador's north wall.
tasks.notes: Use a mithril grapple and crossbow (or enhanced grappling hook from their tool belt) to climb over Falador's north wall then jump down the other side.

tasks.name: It's Nothing Personal
tasks.desc: Increase your reputation with the White Knights by killing a Black Knight.
tasks.notes:
Kill a Black Knight in order to increase their rank with the White Knights.
Any black knight found throughout Gielinor will work for this, not just those in Asgarnia.

tasks.name: Ice the Icy
tasks.desc: Kill an ice giant in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Kill an ice giant within the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
As ice giants are level 47, it is advised to take combat gear. As they are weak to fire spells, it is advised to bring magic gear.

tasks.name: Blinded With Science
tasks.desc: Light a bullseye lantern in the chemist's.
other: 20 Smithing Smithing (to make the bullseye lantern (frame))
49 Crafting Crafting (to make the lantern lens)
tasks.notes:
Light a bullseye lantern within the Chemist's House in Rimmington.
The lantern only needs to be lit within the premises, it does not have to be constructed there. Sapphire and emerald lanterns also work.

tasks.name: They Have Families to Feed
tasks.desc: Pickpocket a Falador guard.
tasks.notes: Pickpocket a guard in Falador.

tasks.name: Stoic Sweetcorn Guardian
tasks.desc: Place a scarecrow to protect your sweetcorn in the patch north of Port Sarim.
other: 47 Farming Farming (to obtain a watermelon for the scarecrow)
tasks.notes:
Plant a scarecrow in the flower patch at the Falador farm while having sweetcorn growing in the allotment patch.
Only one allotment patch needs to have sweetcorn growing in it. The order in which the scarecrow and sweetcorn are placed does not matter, as the achievement will be completed once both patches are filled.

tasks.name: Look Spiffy For Tiffy
tasks.desc: Salute Sir Tiffy while wearing full initiate armour.
tasks.notes:
Use the salute emote before Sir Tiffy Cashien while wearing full initiate armour.
Goblin Salute will also work for this.

tasks.name: Do They Come in Other Colours?
tasks.desc: Smith some blurite crossbow limbs on Thurgo's anvil.
tasks.notes: Smith a set of blurite limbs on the anvil in Thurgo's hut. Blurite rocks can be found within the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon mine to the east of Thurgo's hut.

tasks.name: These Aren't the Coins You're Looking For
tasks.desc: Travel from Port Sarim to Musa Point for free (with a little help from Charos).
tasks.notes: Use the ring of charos (a) to travel from Port Sarim to Musa Point for free.

tasks.name: Kitty Litter
tasks.desc: Summon a cat or kitten at the sandy patch by 'The Face' in Port Sarim.
tasks.notes:
Summon a cat or kitten in the sandy patch in Port Sarim next to Felkrash and The Face.
Any kind of cat or kitten, except clockwork cats, will work. Players must stand in the centre of the sandy circle, 3 tiles north of the full fishing net and summon/drop their cat from their inventory. The full fishing net is located at the north-east corner of the fishing shop.

tasks.name: It Matches My Eyes
tasks.desc: Dye a cape pink using dye from Betty in Port Sarim.
tasks.notes: Dye a regular cape (such as a cape (red)) pink using pink dye obtained from Betty in Port Sarim after The Hand in the Sand. The pink dye cannot be purchased from her shop. Instead, it must be purchased through dialogue with Betty.

tasks.name: Child of Saradomin
tasks.desc: Change your family crest to the Saradomin symbol.
tasks.notes:
Change their family crest to the Saradominist symbol at Sir Renitee, located on the east end of the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of the White Knights' Castle.
Sir Renitee will give players a money crest voucher if they had the money crest prior to changing the symbol for the task, which reduces the cost of switching the crest back.

tasks.name: Mass Production
tasks.desc: Craft 140 or more mind runes simultaneously, without using pouches or familiars.
tasks.notes:
Craft 140 mind runes simultaneously without using runecrafting pouches, familiars. Players cannot bring essence that is stored in any of the ethereal outfits while completing this achievement but the outfit can be worn while doing this achievement.
An inventory of 28 pure essence or rune essence requires a multiplier of 5 to get to 140 mind runes.

tasks.name: It Spoiled My View
tasks.desc: Cut down a yew or magic tree that you grew in Falador Park.
tasks.notes: Chop down a yew or magic tree grown in the Farming patch in Falador Park.

tasks.name: The Stonemasons
tasks.desc: Enter the Mining Guild.
tasks.notes: Enter the Mining Guild.

tasks.name: I Heard You Like Mudskips
tasks.desc: Dial to the fairy ring on Mudskipper Point.
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes:
Dial to the fairy ring on Mudskipper Point.
The code is AIQ. Players must be wielding either a dramen or lunar staff in order to use the fairy ring network, unless if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift is complete.

tasks.name: The Mogre Mash
tasks.desc: Kill a mogre at Mudskipper Point.
tasks.notes: Kill a mogre at Mudskipper Point.

tasks.name: Why Oh Wyvern
tasks.desc: Kill a skeletal wyvern in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Kill a skeletal Wyvern in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
As the skeletal wyverns are level 109, combat gear is advised. They are weak to fire spells, so magic gear is advised. Skeletal wyverns have a breath attack which can be defended against by using any elemental workshop shield or dragonfire shield. Alternately, a wyrmfire potion, overload salve or supreme overload salve can also be used to block the damage, though no other potion will work.

tasks.name: Banned For Life
tasks.desc: Summon an ibis in Port Sarim's fishing store.
tasks.notes: Summon an ibis within Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim.

tasks.name: A Knight in the Darkness
tasks.desc: Ascend the Dark Wizards' Tower while wearing full proselyte armour.
tasks.notes: Climb to the top of the Dark Wizards' Tower west of Falador while wearing full proselyte armour.

tasks.name: When This Cavern's Rockin'...
tasks.desc: Catch a rocktail in the Living Rock Caverns.
tasks.notes: Catch a raw rocktail in the Living Rock Caverns. Players may catch rocktails using a fishing rod and living minerals at level 90 Fishing. If lacking the required level, temporary skill boosts can be used.

tasks.name: ...You'd Best Come A-cookin'
tasks.desc: Cook a rocktail on a range in the Falador area.
tasks.notes: Cook a raw rocktail on a range in the Falador area, which can be found directly east of the estate agent house.

tasks.name: Concentration Is Key
tasks.desc: Mine concentrated gold in the Living Rock Caverns.
tasks.notes:
Mine from the concentrated gold deposits located in the Living Rock Caverns.
The living rock creatures are aggressive, but can be pacified by wearing the magic golem outfit or fury shark outfit.
Having Grace of the Elves or a similar Sign of the Porter effect enabled, you may not be able to earn the achievement.

tasks.name: I Swear I Heard It Scream
tasks.desc: Chop down a magic tree grown in your tree patch in Falador Park.
tasks.notes: Cut down a magic tree grown in the Farming patch in Falador Park.

tasks.name: I've Changed My Mind!
tasks.desc: Use a summoned hydra to regrow a tree in your patch in Falador Park.
tasks.notes: Use a hydra's special move Regrowth to regrow a felled tree planted in the Farming patch in Falador Park.

tasks.name: A String and a Flare
tasks.desc: Cast the String Jewellery spell while standing at the furnace in Falador.
tasks.notes: Cast String Jewellery while standing at the furnace in Falador

tasks.name: Altar-ed State
tasks.desc: Use the altar in the White Knights' Castle to switch curses off, while you have Turmoil active.
tasks.notes:
Switch from curses to prayers while at the White Knights' Castle altar and having Turmoil active.
The altar is found on the 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US). If the ability to swap back to prayers at any altar has been disabled, it must be reactivated at the Zarosian altar in Senntisten Temple or the elven grimoire in the Cadarn district of Prifddinas.
